sql_template:
SELECT
  a.order_id,
  a.invoice_number,
  a.created_date,
  a.diff_shipping_charge,
  a.diff_shipping_charge_tax,
  'addition_charge_without_settlement_match' AS mismatch_category
FROM zs_observe.nykaa_addition_charge a
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.nykaa_settlement s
  ON a.order_id = s.order_id
 AND s.is_active = true
 AND s.group_level_id = 22
WHERE a.is_active = true
  AND a.group_level_id = 22
  AND s.order_id IS NULL
ORDER BY a.created_date DESC;

sql_template:
SELECT
  a.order_id,
  a.invoice_number,
  a.previous_shipping_charges,
  a.revised_freight,
  a.diff_shipping_charge,
  a.diff_shipping_charge_tax,
  s.settled_amount,

  ON a.order_id = s.order_id
 AND s.is_active = true
 AND s.group_level_id = 22
WHERE a.is_active = true
  AND a.group_level_id = 22
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(a.diff_shipping_charge,0)) DESC
LIMIT 100;

sql_template:
SELECT
  order_id,
  invoice_number,
  transaction_type,
  final_status,
  ROUND(SUM(charged_amount), 2) AS charged,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(gross_commission,0)), 2) AS commission,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(gross_commission_gst_amount,0)), 2) AS commission_gst,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mp_fees,0)), 2) AS mp_fees,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mp_fees_gst_amount,0)), 2) AS mp_fee_gst,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(total_tcs_amount,0)), 2) AS tcs,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(shipping_amount,0)), 2) AS shipping,
  ROUND(SUM(charged_amount - COALESCE(gross_commission,0) - COALESCE(gross_commission_gst_amount,0) - COALESCE(mp_fees,0) - COALESCE(mp_fees_gst_amount,0) - COALESCE(total_tcs_amount,0) - COALESCE(shipping_amount,0)), 2) AS expected_settled_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(settled_amount), 2) AS settled_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(actual_settlement), 2) AS actual_settlement,
  ROUND(SUM(settled_amount) - SUM(charged_amount - COALESCE(gross_commission,0) - COALESCE(gross_commission_gst_amount,0) - COALESCE(mp_fees,0) - COALESCE(mp_fees_gst_amount,0) - COALESCE(total_tcs_amount,0) - COALESCE(shipping_amount,0)), 2) AS variance
FROM zs_observe.nykaa_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
  AND group_level_id = 22
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY ABS(variance) DESC
LIMIT 100;
summary: Order-level waterfall from charged, commission, mp_fees, TCS, settled, actual_settlement.

WITH mg_joined AS (
  SELECT
    mg.*,
    ARRAY_JOIN(SLICE(SPLIT(mg.magentoorderno, '-'), 1, 3), '-') AS base_order_id
  FROM zs_observe.nykaa_mapper_gst mg

  o.final_status AS oms_status,
  o.charged_amount

INNER JOIN zs_observe.nykaa_oms o
  ON m.base_order_id = o.order_id
 AND o.is_active = true
 AND o.group_level_id = 22
LIMIT 100;

sql_template:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month,
         SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_sales
  FROM zs_observe.nykaa_oms
  WHERE is_active = true
    AND transaction_type = 'forward'
    AND group_level_id = 22
  GROUP BY 1
), lagged AS (
  SELECT month, gross_sales, LAG(gross_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_gross_sales
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, gross_sales, previous_gross_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (gross_sales - previous_gross_sales) / NULLIF(previous_gross_sales, 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM lagged
ORDER BY month;
summary: Use LAG over monthly gross_sales.

  CASE
    WHEN diff_shipping_charge IS NULL THEN 'null'
    WHEN diff_shipping_charge = 0 THEN 'zero'
    WHEN diff_shipping_charge BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN '0_to_10'
    WHEN diff_shipping_charge BETWEEN 10 AND 50 THEN '10_to_50'

  COUNT(*) AS rows,
  ROUND(SUM(diff_shipping_charge), 2) AS total_diff_shipping_charge,
  ROUND(SUM(diff_shipping_charge_tax), 2) AS total_diff_shipping_charge_tax
